//: 🔴 `electron.vite.config.ts` IS DELIBERATELY NOT IN `include`, AND REMOVING IT IS WHAT MADE
THIS PROJECT TYPE-CHECK AT ALL. It sits at the repo root, outside `rootDir: ./src`, which made
tsc report TS6059 — a CONFIGURATION error that aborts the program before any semantic analysis.
Measured on 08/10/2026: a deliberate `const x: number = 'a string'` inside src/main produced
ZERO errors. So every line of main and preload went unchecked, and `npm run build` cannot catch
it either — electron-vite strips types with esbuild and never checks them. The whole cutter
(skycut-protocol.ts, skycut-engine.ts, CuttingPlotter.tsx — about 4,700 lines) shipped in 2.3.39
The same misconfiguration also emitted `electron.vite.config.js` and `.d.ts` into the repo root
on any `tsc -p` run without --noEmit, and electron-vite resolves the .js BEFORE the .ts — so a
stale compiled copy silently outranked the real config. Both are gitignored now.
⚠️ The vite config itself is therefore unchecked by tsc. That is the lesser loss by a wide
margin, and vite validates its own config at build time. If it ever needs checking, give it its
own tsconfig with `rootDir: "."` rather than putting it back here.
CHECK IT WITH:  npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
and if it ever reports nothing at all, break something on purpose and make sure it complains.
